nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the quadrinomial coefficient $\binom{n}{k}_4$ is the coefficient of $x^k$ in the polynomial $(1 + x + x^2 + x^3)^n$ with natural-number coefficients. These numbers form the triangle OEIS A008287.
nodes.title: Quadrinomial coefficient triangle

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the quadrinomial number $Q(n) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k} \binom{n}{2k}$ equals Zhang's six-parameter binomial sum $V(n, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)$.
nodes.title: Quadrinomial numbers as a specialization of Zhang's V-sum

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the quadrinomial number is $Q(n) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k} \binom{n}{2k}$. This is OEIS sequence A005725.
nodes.title: Quadrinomial sequence A005725
